claim.claim-text: 1. A system comprising:

a processor; a graphics processing unit; and a memory device containing instructions, which when executed by the processor cause the processor to: at runtime, for each node of a first layer of a neural network model:
determine a second operation performed at the node of the second layer; and determine whether to override an annotation of the second operation performed at the node of the second layer.

2. The system of claim 1, wherein to determine whether to override the annotation of the operation performed at the node further comprises: determining whether the processor or the graphics processing unit supports the operation.
3. The system of claim 2, wherein determining whether the processor or the graphics processing unit supports the operation is based on a registry of operations.
4. The system of claim 1, wherein to determine whether to override the annotation of the operation performed at the node is based on one or more of:
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the first layer comprises an output layer.
6. A method comprising: at runtime, for each node of a first layer of a neural network model:
determining a second operation performed at the node; and determining whether to override an annotation of the second operation performed at the node.

7. The method of claim 6, wherein determining whether to override the annotation of the operation performed at the node further comprises: determining whether the processor or the graphics processing unit supports the operation.
8. The method of claim 7, wherein determining whether the processor or the graphics processing unit supports the operation is based on a registry of operations.
9. The method of claim 6, wherein determining whether to override the annotation of the operation performed at the node is based on one or more of:
10. The method of claim 6, wherein the first layer comprises an output layer.

11. A computer-readable medium comprising instructions, which when executed by a computing device, cause the computing device to perform operations comprising: at runtime, for each node of a first layer of a neural network model:
determining a second operation performed at the node of the second layer; and determining whether to override an annotation of the second operation performed at the node of the second layer.
12. The computer-readable medium of claim 11, wherein the first layer comprises an output layer.

13. The computer-readable medium of claim 11 or 12, wherein determining whether to override the annotation of the operation performed at the node is based on a priority of the processor and a priority of the graphics processing unit.
